title: Vehicle registration renewal reminder
description: Remind drivers that their registration or inspection is about to expire. Utility WhatsApp template for dealers and service centers.
notes: Use the plate number and exact expiry to keep it utility. Add a booking link as the single call to action.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, the {{document}} for your vehicle with plate *{{plate}}* expires on {{expiry_date}}. We can handle it for you.
